blockedRunSummary: {count} error(s) must be fixed before this workflow can run.
connectorEgressPolicy: Connector-triggered external sink {kind} must explicitly choose Block or Redact before publishing.
containerBoundary: This connection crosses a loop container boundary ({source} → {target}).
credentialMissing: References a credential that isn't configured ({ref}).
danglingSource: This connection starts from a node that no longer exists ({ref}).
danglingTarget: This connection points to a node that no longer exists ({ref}).
desktopOnlyInWeb: This node only runs in the desktop app and will be skipped in the browser.
duplicateEdgeId: Duplicate connection id — the workflow file is malformed.
duplicateNodeId: Duplicate node id — the workflow file is malformed.
exprNotUpstream: References {ref}, which isn't upstream of this node, so its output won't be available.
flowOutsideLoop: {kind} must live inside a loop body.
graphCycle: Part of a cycle ({nodes}). Back-edges never re-execute — move the nodes that should repeat inside a Loop container instead.
joinPolicyInLoop: Join policy "{policy}" is ignored inside a loop body — loop subgraphs always wait for ALL branches. Move the join to the top level for any/race semantics.
kindRetired: This node ({kind}) was removed in {removedIn} and can no longer run. Re-author this step, or install the compatibility plugin that provides it.
missingParent: Belongs to a container ({parentId}) that no longer exists.
missingTrigger: No trigger node — this workflow can only be started manually.
orphanNode: Not reachable from any trigger; it will never run.
parentNotContainer: Its container ({parentId}) isn't a loop container.
pluginUnavailable: The plugin providing this node ({kind}) isn't installed.
selfParent: A node can't be its own container.
synthesizerOnly: This node is emitted by the {lifecycle, select, team {agent-team} plan {plan} other {}} synthesizer and needs that run's context. Run it through action.team.run (or action.plan.run) instead of this workflow's Run button.
